# Image attributions

## Status (2026-08-26)

`hero.jpg`, `ambiance1.jpg`, and `ambiance2.jpg` are genuine Gemini
generations (generated via the `gemini-image-generator` tool),
replacing the literal R and Shiny logos, the literal Quarto wordmark
logo (previously inserted directly as `quarto-logo.png` rather than
via the ambiance1 slot), and a generic debugging-session screenshot
respectively. `ambiance3.jpg` (the Geisel Library photo) was already
genuine.

- `hero.jpg`: two different gears, one large and one small, meshed
  together and turning. Metaphor: two different systems (R and
  JavaScript) working together.
- `ambiance1.jpg`: a sheet of tracing paper laid over a printed
  diagram, revealing a second, complementary drawing sketched on top.
  Metaphor: one document layer combining two different tools.
- `ambiance2.jpg`: two pens, one fountain pen and one mechanical
  pencil, writing on the same open page from opposite corners.
  Metaphor: two languages contributing to one document.

All three processed via `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85` to
1600x873.
